title: 问题发生与描述
html:
问题发生与描述

概述

本章是问题处理链条的第一环——把问题说清楚，涵盖问题描述词汇、状态与严重程度、报告问题常用句型、影响与范围四个部分。描述准确是后续分析和解决的前提，因此本章重点提供界定问题、说明影响所需的核心词与句式。每个部分配有听说例句与写作表达，适用于口头报告和书面记录两种场合。建议把描述词与严重程度、影响范围一起记忆，便于一次性说清问题的全貌。

问题描述词汇

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
issue n. 问题 critical issue, address an issue
bug n. 缺陷 fix a bug, report a bug
incident n. 事故 production incident, incident report
outage n. 宕机 service outage, scheduled outage
bottleneck n. 瓶颈 performance bottleneck, identify bottleneck
regression n. 回归 regression bug, prevent regression

听说例句

A: We have a critical issue in production. B: What's the impact? Is it a full outage or partial?

A: QA found a regression in the latest build. B: Let me check the commit history. It might be related to yesterday's merge.

写作表达

  • A production incident was reported at 14:30 UTC, resulting in a 20-minute service outage affecting 5% of users.
  • The performance bottleneck was traced to an unoptimized database query in the user profile module.

状态与严重程度

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
severity n. 严重程度 high severity, severity level
priority n. 优先级 top priority, set priority
blocker n. 阻断问题 release blocker, critical blocker
intermittent adj. 间歇性的 intermittent failure, intermittent issue
reproducible adj. 可复现的 easily reproducible, not reproducible
degraded adj. 降级的 degraded performance, degraded service

听说例句

A: What's the severity of this bug? B: It's a P0 blocker. Users can't complete checkout. We need a hotfix ASAP.

A: Is the issue reproducible? B: It's intermittent — happens about 10% of the time, mostly on older devices.

写作表达

  • The issue has been classified as high severity due to its direct impact on revenue-generating flows.
  • Degraded performance was observed across multiple regions during peak traffic hours.

报告问题常用句型

表达 含义 场景
I noticed that... 我注意到... 初次报告
It appears that... 看起来... 初步判断
We're experiencing... 我们正在遇到... 实时描述
This started happening after... 这是在...之后开始发生的 关联变更
The expected behavior is... but... 预期行为是...但是... 对比描述
Steps to reproduce: ... 复现步骤：... 技术报告

听说例句

A: I noticed that the search results are loading much slower today. B: It appears that the CDN cache was invalidated. We're experiencing higher latency as a result.

A: When did this start? B: This started happening after we deployed the v2.3 release yesterday evening.

写作表达

  • The expected behavior is a response time under 200ms, but we are currently seeing p99 latency above 800ms.
  • Steps to reproduce: 1) Log in as a guest user; 2) Navigate to the cart page; 3) Observe the 500 error.

影响与范围

词汇 词性 含义 常用搭配
impact n./v. 影响 business impact, impact assessment
scope n. 范围 scope of impact, within scope
affected adj. 受影响的 affected users, affected regions
downstream adj. 下游的 downstream services, downstream impact
cascade v./n. 级联 cascade failure, cascading effect
workaround n. 临时方案 temporary workaround, suggest a workaround

听说例句

A: How many users are affected? B: About 15,000 users in the APAC region. There's also a downstream impact on the notification service.

A: Is there a workaround while we fix this? B: Yes, users can clear their cache and retry. It's a temporary workaround but it works.

写作表达

  • The impact assessment indicates that approximately 8% of daily active users were affected by the outage.
  • A cascading failure in the authentication service caused downstream disruptions to three dependent microservices.
